import os, sys
_LQE = os.environ.get("LQE_PATH", os.path.abspath(os.path.join("..", "legitimate_quantum_engine_v5.0")))
_ECO = os.environ.get("LQE_ECOSYSTEM_PATH", os.path.abspath(".."))
for _p in (_LQE, _ECO):
    if _p not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, _p)
from legitimate_quantum_engine.tensor_networks.mps_simulator import mps_ghz_state
from legitimate_quantum_engine.core.statevector import StatevectorSim
import numpy as np
n=4
mps = mps_ghz_state(n)
sim = StatevectorSim(n)
sim.apply('H', 0)
for q in range(n-1): sim.apply('CNOT', q, q+1)
nz = np.where(np.abs(sim.state)>0.1)[0]
print(f'MPS type: {type(mps).__name__}')
print(f'Exact GHZ nonzero indices: {nz}')
